source: https://airsuvidha.civilaviation.gov.in/ (form page and its front-end checks in assets/index-B8XoKYWM.js, read 2026-11-18 in a browser; the arrival-date picker allowed today to 3 days ahead), https://airsuvidha.civilaviation.gov.in/faq (72-hour window, OTP by email for non-Indian numbers). Only checks the form itself applies are kept. We did not submit the form.

full_name.label: Full name (as per passport)
full_name.help: The form takes 3 to 120 characters: letters, plus spaces, hyphens, apostrophes, commas and periods. No digits or other symbols.

errors.required: Please enter full name (at least 3 characters)
errors.tooShort: Please enter full name (at least 3 characters)
errors.tooLong: Full name must be at most 120 characters
errors.invalidChars: Use letters only, as on your passport (spaces, hyphens, apostrophes, commas, and periods are allowed)

passport_number.label: Passport number
passport_number.help: Exactly as printed on the passport: 7 to 20 letters and digits. Indian passports must be 7 to 8 characters with up to 2 letters at the start, such as A1234567.

errors.tooShort: Passport number must be at least 7 characters (as on your passport)

age.label: Age
age.help: Whole years, digits only, 0 to 120. The form asks for age, not date of birth.

errors.invalidFormat: Age must be a whole number between 0 and 120

arrival_date.label: Arrival date in India (IST)
arrival_date.help: dd-mm-yyyy in India time. The form opens 72 hours before arrival: on 18 November 2026 its date picker allowed 18 to 21 November. Arrival time is a separate 15-minute list.

errors.required: Please choose a valid arrival date
errors.tooEarly: The arrival date cannot be in the past
errors.tooLate: Too early: the form can only be filled up to 72 hours before arrival in India
errors.invalidDay: That day does not exist in this month

mobile_india.label: Mobile number, if Indian (+91)
mobile_india.help: Only for a +91 number: 10 digits starting with 6, 7, 8 or 9, no country code. The OTP goes to this number and to your email.

errors.invalidFormat: Enter a valid Indian mobile number (10 digits starting with 6, 7, 8, or 9)

mobile_other.label: Mobile number, if not Indian
mobile_other.help: 7 to 15 digits; the country code is chosen in a separate list. With a non-Indian number the OTP is sent by email only.

errors.invalidFormat: Enter a valid mobile number (7–15 digits)

email.label: Email address
email.help: Your own address, not a travel agent's: the OTP, the confirmation and later edits all go through it.
